action.objective: Advance d2d4, the verified best plan, challenging Black's center and opening the position.
action.rationale: d2d4 is the only commit-ready move: verified at full depth with exact score 42 (strongest exact evidence in this position), complete mate-in-one safety check (forced_mate false), and no tactical refutation found. It advances the center, attacks e5 knight and c5, and opens lines for the c1 bishop and d1 queen. Black's likely exd3 reply is met by Bxd3, keeping the initiative. No comparison reserve is needed since this is the single verified candidate with the best exact score and favorable king-safety/development assessment.
